Question
========
Why are growth and education described as "hardly the silver bullets"?

Answerlist
----------
* They matter, but growth gains can be captured by the top and education alone does not change power relations
* Because they increase inequality in all cases
* Because they are too expensive
* Because they are irrelevant for poverty

Solution
========
Growth and education are important levers, but without changes in distribution and bargaining power they do not reduce inequality on their own.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
